GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the mare, rider stated that his mount was slow to begin and settled further back than anticipated and was unsuited due to the moderate tempo of the race. He nevertheless added that when placed under pressure in the straight his mount proved disappointing in its failure to respond to his riding. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length settled 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages and near the 800m when the tempo slackened was shifted wider when awkwardly placed on heels, raced wide and without cover from this point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair pressed on to lead 1 length clear, ridden along turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed passing 200m, battled on well juts no match winner once headed # led/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re leading, rdr explained after beginning fairly he initially anticipated settling in a midfield position with cover, however when he observed the tempo of the race to be slow in the early stages, and bearing in mind that his mount has had a tendency to race keenly in its previous starts, he allowed the mare to improve to obtain the lead. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to have an abrasion to the off hindleg. Co-tnr was told a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.
